Maria_CS: Quick heads-up — NebulaWell pilot goes live in SG next Tue. They requested APAC proxy allowlist + a soft QPS bump for the first 72h. Also flagged as a renewal-risk conversation from last call, so capture notes please.
Sophia (NebulaWell): Thanks Maria — schedule is 2026-03-24 09:00 SGT. IPs to allowlist: 203.0.113.12/32 and 198.51.100.7/32. Target soft QPS: 120 (currently ~60). Will revert after 72h. Please confirm once applied.
Maria_CS: Adding @Devon_SE and @Kai_NetOps to action. Tenant id is NBL-947. Preferred apply window 09:00–09:30 SGT Tue. Also FYI they flagged pricing as a renewal concern during last enablement.
Devon_SE: Got it. I'll prepare routing and perf config. @Kai_NetOps can you handle the allowlist + soft window? I need the exact expire time so I can schedule the cost snapshot and a short post-mortem.
Kai_NetOps: I can do this. Will provision on apac-proxy cluster and set auto-revoke at 72h. ETA: will have changes staged ~2h before start. Pasting planned config: ```
allowlist:
  tenant: NBL-947
  cidrs: ["203.0.113.12/32","198.51.100.7/32"]
qps:
  soft_limit: 120
  duration: 72h
  expire_at: 2026-03-27T09:00:00+08:00
notes: "pilot - auto-revoke"
```
oncall-bot: Config change staged by Kai_NetOps for tenant NBL-947 on apac-1. Staging ID: stg-8f3a. Will apply at scheduled window.
Kai_NetOps: Applied to apac-1: patch id 8f3a -> live. Allowlist and soft QPS activated. Monitoring set to alert on 5xx > 0.5% or token latency > 300ms.
Sophia (NebulaWell): Confirming traffic shows 2xx and throughput rising toward 120 qps. No errors so far. Thank you.
Maria_CS: Capturing feedback: please file any anomalies in the support ticket. Devon, can you create a 15-minute post-mortem checkpoint 24h after start and produce a perf+cost snapshot for renewal materials?
Devon_SE: Will do. I'll pull token-level latency and cost per 1k tokens, plus a short note on optimization opportunities (batching/cache). Will post in this channel after 24h.
Maria_CS: :thumbsup: I'll schedule the 72h renewal check-in with the customer and add a renewal action to CRM (NBL-947).
Sophia (NebulaWell): One more ask — can you keep request logs for 14 days? Compliance team may need them.
Devon_SE: Yes, enabling 14d log retention for tenant NBL-947 now. I'll confirm when set.
Kai_NetOps: Confirmed: 14d logs enabled and retention tag applied. Closing config loop. If anything spikes, I'll page oncall.
Maria_CS: Great — capturing this thread in the account health notes and marking as 'pilot: successful config applied'. Will follow up post-24h.
